The story makes sophisticated use of metaphor to convey the somber, eerie, and nostalgic atmosphere of the setting. For example, the narrator describes the gray light of a November afternoon falling into the hallway and gathering into "shallow puddles" on the tiles (*"...damit das graue Licht eines Novembernachmittags hereinfiel und sich auf den Fliesen zu flachen Pfützen sammelte"*). This metaphor gives the gloomy, stagnant light a heavy, liquid quality. Additionally, the narrator recalls the kitchen filling with a "warmth that didn't come from the heater" (*"...einer Wärme füllte, die nicht von der Heizung kam"*), using warmth as a metaphor for the emotional comfort and love of their mother's presence. Finally, the strong scent of coffee is described as "hitting" the narrator physically (*"...der Duft traf mich so unvermittelt..."*), effectively illustrating the sudden, overwhelming power of memory.
